# Datasets Used in the Cross-Lingual Parkinson's Disease Speech Classification Study

## Introduction

The study under review proposes a methodology for classifying Parkinson's disease (PD) from speech in three different languages — Spanish, German, and Czech — by combining convolutional neural networks (CNNs) trained on time–frequency representations with a cross-lingual transfer learning strategy ([Vasquez-Correa et al., 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.04374)). Because the central contribution of the work is the extent to which knowledge learned from one language's speech data can be transferred to another, the datasets occupy a defining role in the research design.
